basic_profile.headline: Brand & Partnerships Manager | Community, Experiential Marketing & Product Storytelling
basic_profile.name: Zuny Molano
basic_profile.summary:
Brand and culture-driven marketer with 7+ years of experience leading brand partnerships, talent collaborations, and integrated campaigns for consumer and lifestyle brands.

Founder of a multidisciplinary creative studio, partnering closely with founders and brands to shape strategy, storytelling, experiential marketing, and creator programs from concept through execution.

My background includes driving high-profile partnerships and activations for national and international brands, managing celebrity and talent collaborations, and translating cultural moments into thoughtful, high-impact campaigns across digital, experiential, and retail environments.

I’m known for strong creative judgment, relationship-building, and a hands-on approach that bridges strategy with real-world execution.

Open to collaborations and roles across brand partnerships, marketing, storytelling, and integrated campaigns.

past.company_description: We believe that whole food based nutrition containing collagen is essential for one’s overall health, beauty, fitness and well-being. Our ancestors utilized sustainable whole animal nutrition, which provided an abundant amount of collagen. Over the past century modern food processing has removed this natural and healthy protein from our diets. Collagen is vital for our body and is the basic building block of skin, hair, nails, bones and joints. We promote optimal health, beauty, vibrant youth, and overall wellness with our products.We are dedicated to providing 100% natural, whole food proteins that support animal well-being and sustainable eco-friendly practices. Our happy cows openly graze on lush natural grass pastures providing the highest quality of protein.
